cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: All wins in the current symbol drop are collected and thereafter all symbols which were part of a winning combination explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically, slide to the left and then right repeatedly until they reach a resting position. An additional row is added at the top and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 4x6. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).

The remaining symbols fall vertically, slide to the left and then right repeatedly until they reach a resting position. An additional row is added at the top and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

phases.name: End-of-drop features
